falsification_contract.HYPOTHESIS: expected effect holds: Total failure of any one cell or module no longer disables door releases, locks, or emergency communications, because remaining modules keep the critical loads energized; degradation-driven failures a (recorded prior 0.6, epistemic class MODEL_DERIVED per the killer-experiment provenance)
falsification_contract.TREATMENT: Replace the single 12V battery with a distributed low-voltage storage bank of multiple independent cell modules, each on its own fused power path to critical safety loads (rear/exterior manual door releases, mechanical locking, emergency communications), and add a per-cell health monitor that tracks individual cell degradation rates so a failing cell is detected and electrically isolated before it takes down the whole low-voltage bus.
falsification_contract.CONTROL_BLOCKER: no executed baseline comparison on record (physics chain executed: ['PRE_REQUIREMENTS']; lifecycle MECHANISM_NOT_SIMULATABLE) — the control arm is not invented from the problem statement
falsification_contract.MEASUREMENT: In a bench vehicle, force a hard short/dead-short on one 12V cell module and verify with a multimeter and functional test that rear manual door releases, exterior manual releases, mechanical locks, and emergency communications still operate continuously for at least 30 minutes; separately, run accelerated cycling and confirm the per-cell monitor flags the failing module (capacity/resistance trend crossing threshold) at least 50 cycles before it fails.
falsification_contract.APPARATUS: the falsification test's own recorded instrumentation (stated within MEASUREMENT; not split out — no separate apparatus record exists)
falsification_contract.SAMPLE_BLOCKER: no sample-size / n= record exists in any engine stage (honest UNKNOWN — Art. XXV)
